column1: # Accuracy and uniqueness vs minibwa. Source: Testing/notes/UNIQUE_VS_MINIBWA.md (festive c25e1e1; lean-align 027ef1e, minibwa c07de5c, measured before the slow-pair fixes)

# real: first 200k pairs of the bench release's novaseq_200k and hg002_200k (HiSeq 2x250); values are % of all pairs. 'unique' = our XU:Z:unique vs minibwa MAPQ 60 on both mates; pct_q30 = minibwa MAPQ >= 30 on both.
# agree: of pairs both tools call unique. sim: Testing/benches/sim_pairs.py seed 1, 100k pairs; a pair is correct if both mates start within 10 bp of the truth; class = OUR class (n pairs).
